# Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 26 (Bu-Vb Pc26)

**ID:** Bu-Vb Pc26
**Section:** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga (bu-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 26
**Title (English, from literature):** Sewing a robe for a nun
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul0.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

*Cīvarasibbana* ("Sewing a robe for a nun"), designated as Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 26, lays down an offense of expiation (*pācittiya*) for any Buddhist monk who sews, or causes to be sewn, a robe for an unrelated nun. According to the rule formulation in the Vinaya Piṭaka, a monk committing this transgression must confess the offense. An English translation of the rule and its associated case narrative has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
